name: Sasatsuka Miyu
source:
[If you say "I'll give you a candy, come with this old man ^^", she'll probably follow you...Dangerous natural loli with big breasts! ]

A first year student who entered the school this year like the main character.
She is short for her age, has a childish face, and has a mature body...
As soon as she entered the school, she became famous as the school's biggest loli with big breasts.
Her facial expressions change between happy, angry, and sad, and she has a hundred faces that are cute and interesting to watch.
She has a positive personality and works hard at everything, but she has a natural tendency to be lacking in things and is a clumsy child who often makes mistakes.
Besides, she's pure... or rather, she's not very smart, so she shouldn't cheat.

“Um, where have you been looking?”
